casePolicy.scope: New external audio introduced for the koto research and comparison work only; not a permanent ban on other licenses or a removal rule for existing assets.
casePolicy.authority: Autonomous in-scope adoption when provenance, rights, ethics and quality satisfy the documented gates; no project-owner preapproval gate.

roles.creator: RutgerMuller
roles.recordist: RutgerMuller (inferred from upload and first-person recording description; sole recorder not independently established)

licenseEvidence.method: Exa full-page read plus direct public HTML inspection; timestamp records completion of retrieval after the label check
licenseEvidence.shortRecord: Individual sound page links CC0 1.0; creator profile confirms CC0, requests creative transformation and no misleading collaboration credit. Public share-url metadata links the high-quality MP3 preview; original WAV download requires login.

confirmedScope: Uploader explicitly identifies own improvised koto performance; CC0 selected for this recording.
Creator profile and official biography independently describe publishing own field recordings under CC0.
rights.basis: Reasonable provenance basis for a candidate, not a warranty of sole rights or a verified 13-string instrument.

thirdParty.composition: Uploader describes own improvisation; no named third-party composition or commercial source is declared. Distinctive phrases will not be copied into the independent score.
thirdParty.performance: Uploader explicitly describes being the player. No other performer is credited for these sessions.
thirdParty.recording: Zoom H2n stereo MS, mid-October 2016, Kashiwa, Chiba, Japan, microphone under instrument, according to uploader. Sole recording authorship is not independently proved.
thirdParty.otherRights: No third-party library or commercial track is declared. Audible speech, other music, privacy and contamination must be checked on any proposed cut.
thirdParty.intent: Profile requests creative transformation; discourages commercial redistribution of unedited sounds and misleading collaboration credit. Treat these as ethical requests separately from CC0 conditions.
thirdParty.conclusion: Rights provenance is sufficiently plausible for private candidate analysis. Adoption still requires cut-specific quality/third-party checks and truthful instrument identification.

steps: Public HTML used to resolve the explicit share-url high-quality MP3; no guessed original URL or authentication bypass.

tools.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

quality.evidence: MP3 partial range decodes successfully to 48 kHz stereo PCM16; this verifies file usability only. Original page describes 96 kHz/24-bit WAV, which was not acquired.
limitations: Lossy MP3 preview, not original WAV.
Improvisation rather than isolated controlled notes; overlapping decays, finger/pick differences and body-under microphone may limit useful cuts.
No human listening or final sample-selection quality acceptance recorded.

uncertainties: No controlled velocity layers or round robins declared.
Original WAV unavailable without account login; no credential use or bypass attempted.
Partial end must not be mistaken for a natural decay; cut boundaries and third-party sounds need assessment.
No external recording adopted into public assets at this snapshot.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Original source explicitly describes thirteen strings and one sample per note, but not CC0. Mirror CC-BY label cannot convert original terms into CC0.
13 Strings KOTO, but no CC0-1.0 statement established; no audio acquired.
Mixed-license pack; CC0 label for other recordings does not cover koto.
No first-person recording/performance/composition provenance, source and title unresolved; no audio acquired.
Single-note samples are a 23-string kayageum, not verified thirteen-string koto.
Synth oscillator bank; does not establish real acoustic koto recording provenance.
Musical piece and MIDI; no real recorded koto single-note provenance established.
